en: Akampana was slain and the powerful Sonitakşaa. And Yüpākṣa and Prajangha were destroyed (there) in the great conflict.

sa: इक्ष्वाकूणां वरिष्ठस्य रामस्य विदितात्मनः। शुभानि धर्मयुक्तानि वचनानि समर्पयन्॥ श्रावयिष्यामि सर्वाणि मधुरां प्रब्रुवन् गिरम्। श्रद्धास्यति यथा सीता तथा सर्वं समादधे॥
en: She is firmly attached. Uttering the name of Rāma, the foremost of the Ikşvākus, and of subdued soul and lauding his piety and fame in sweet accents, I shall so manage that Sītā might hear and believe them.

sa: शारदस्तिमिरोन्मुक्तो नूनं चन्द्र इवाम्बुदैः। आवृतो वदनं तस्या न विराजति साम्प्रतम्॥
en: Truly her countenance is not appearing beautiful like to the autumnal moon, enveloped with clouds, although cleared off the darkness.

sa: निकृत्तशिरसस्तस्य पतितस्य महीतले। तलं राक्षसेन्द्रस्य दृष्ट्वा तत्र न दृश्यते ॥
en: Beholding the Rākşasa chief fall down on the earth with his head off, his forces fled away from the field.

sa: स तु शूरो महावेगो वीर्यश्लाघी महोदरः। महावर्मणि तं खङ्ग पातयामास दुर्मतिः॥
en: Thereupon the vicious-minded, heroic Mahodara, gifted with great vehemence and proud of his own heroism flung his dagger at (the monkey's) armour.

sa: जग्मतुस्तौ श्रमं वीरौ बाहुयुद्धे परंतपौ। जहार च तदा खङ्गमदूरपरिवर्तिनम्॥
en: Thereupon both of them, highly proficient in fighting with arms, were greatly exhausted. Thereupon they took up daggers.

sa: असत्यानि च युद्धानि संशयो मे न रोचते। कश्च निःसंशयं कार्यं कुर्यात् प्राज्ञः ससंशयम्॥
en: Victory or defeat is uncertain in a battle-I do not (therefore) like to engage in such an uncertain (act). What wise man merges certainty in uncertainly?

sa: विशस्ते वा गृहीते वा रक्षोभिर्मयि संयुगे। नान्यं पश्यामि रामस्य सहायं कार्यसाधने॥
en: If I am killed or captured by Rākşasas in battle, I do not find any who can help Rāma in his enterprise.

sa: ततो जातपरित्रासा शब्दं कुर्यान्मनस्विनी। जानाना मां विशालाक्षी रावणं कामरूपिणम्॥
en: And considering me Rāvaņa wearing shapes at will, that large-eyed and high-minded dame, shall cry piteously for help.

sa: तद् यथा तस्य विक्रान्तमनुरूपं महात्मनः। भवत्याहवशूरस्य तथा त्वमुपपादय॥
en: Do you therefore initiate that work as become that high-souled hero and may display his prowess.

sa: अमात्याः क्षिप्रमाख्यात हैहयस्य नृपस्य वै॥ युद्धार्थ समनुप्राप्तो रावणो नाम मामतः।
en: Do you communicate to the king of Haihayas that Rāvana, the lord of Raksasas, has come to fight with him.

sa: अथ ते राक्षसामात्या ह्वियमाणे दशानने। मुमोक्षयिषवो वालिं रवमाणा अभिद्रुताः॥
en: The Ten-necked demon being thus carried away, his councillors, to release him, pursued, exclaiming, Vali, in the welkin.

sa: ततः स कदनं चक्रे वानराणां महाबलः। भर्तृवाक्येन तेजस्वी स्वेन वीर्येण चोदितः॥
en: Excited by his master's command and empowered by his won prowess that (Rākşasa) gifted with great strength began to assail the monkeys.

sa: नहि तं परिपश्यामि यस्तरेत महोदधिम्। अन्यत्र गरुडाद्वायोरन्यत्र च हनूमतः॥
en: Save Garuda and the Wind-god, and save also Hanumān, him find I not who cross the wide ocean.

sa: एषा सा दृश्यते पम्पा नलिनीचित्रकानना॥ त्वया विहीनो यत्राहं विललाप सुदुःखितः।
en: There is (the lake) Pampa abounding in lilies and skirted by picturesque forest where separated from you, I bewailed piteously.

sa: समुद्रं लवयित्वा तु महानक्रसमाकुलम्। लङ्कामारोहयिष्यामो हनिष्यामश्च ते रिपुम्॥
en: Crossing over the ocean swarming with gigantic alligators, we shall enter Lankā and slay the enemy.

sa: तलप्रहारं तद्रक्षः सुग्रीवेण समुद्यतम्॥ नैपुण्यान्मोचयित्वैनं मुष्टिनोरसि ताडयत्।
en: And receding a little, he baffled its aim and returned one on Sugriva's breast.

sa: मुष्टिप्रहाराभिहतो विरूपाक्षो निशाचरः। तेन खङ्गेन संक्रुद्धः सुग्रीवस्य चमूमुखे ॥ कवचं पातयामास पद्भ्यामभिहतोऽपतत्।
en: Being struck with the fist the night-ranger Virūpākṣa greatly enraged cut down with his dagger Sugriva's armour and tumbled him down with his feet.

sa: इमे शूराः समर्थाश्च सर्वतो हरियूथपाः। त्वत्प्रियार्थं कृतोऽत्साहाः प्रवेष्टुमपि पावकम्। एषां हर्षेण जानामि तर्कश्चापि दृढो मम ॥
en: All these heroes, these leaders of monkeyhordes, who are ardent for they welfare, are competent to enter into fire itself. From their cheerful attitude I know this, and firm is my faith.

sa: किमुक्त्वा बहुधा चापि सर्वथा विजयी भवान्। निमित्तानि च पश्यामि मनो मे संप्रहृष्यति॥
en: And what is the use of dilating? Every way you shall prove victorious. And I see omens, and my mind is filled with delight.

sa: यनिवेदयसे लङ्कां पुरीं भीमस्य रक्षसः। क्षिप्रमेनां वधिष्यामि सत्यमेतद्ब्रवीमि ते॥
en: What you say 'I shall speedily destroy the city of this dreadful Raksasa,' is true, I tell you.

sa: भक्षयन्तः गुमन्धीनि मधूनि च फलानि च। उद्वहन्तो महावृक्षान्मञ्जरीपुञ्जधारिणः॥
en: And some partook of perfumed honey and fruits, and some bore mighty trees, holding the sprouts.

sa: ततः पादपमुद्धृत्य शूरः संप्रधनो हरिः। अभिपत्य जघानास्य प्रमुखे तं महागजम्॥
en: Thereupon uprooting a tree the heroic monkeys, skilled in warfare leaped and struck that huge elephant down in his presence.

sa: सोऽतिविद्धः शितैर्बाणैः कपीन्द्रस्तेन रक्षसा। चुक्रोश च महाक्रोधो वधे चास्य मनो दधे ॥
en: Being assailed by the pointed arrows of the Räksasa that lord of monkeys roared in anger and made up his mind to destroy him.

sa: चिन्तयित्वा ततो दृष्टिं वानरेषु न्यपातयत्। उवाच धीमांस्तेजस्वी हनूमन्तं प्लवंगमम्॥
en: Thinking thus the intelligent and effulgent (Rāma) cast his looks towards the monkeys and spoke to Hanumān, saying.

sa: एवं ते हरिशार्दूला गच्छन्ति बलदर्पिताः। अपश्यन्त गिरिश्रेष्ठं सह्यं गिरिशतायुतम्॥ सरांसि च सुफुल्लानि तटाकानि वराणि च।
en: While thus marching, breathing pride of strength, those tiger-like monkeys saw that foremost of mountains Sahya crowned with hundreds o trees, and weary expanses laughing with flowers, and beautiful tanks.

sa: स विलोक्याथ लङ्केशं जहास दहनोपमः। आदित्य इव दुष्प्रेक्ष्यः स्थितो दानवसत्तमः॥ अथ संदर्शनादेव बलिर्वे विश्वरूपवान्। स गृहीत्वा च तद्रक्ष उत्सङ्गे स्थाप्य चाब्रवीत्॥ दशग्रीव महाबाहो कं ते कामं करोम्यहम्। किमागमनकृत्यं ते ब्रूहि त्वं राक्षसेश्वर॥ एवमुक्तस्तु बलिना रावणो वाक्यमब्रवीत्।
en: Beholding the lord of Lankā, the foremost of Dănavas, resembling the flaming fire, and hard to look at like the sun, laughed. And taking that Rākş asa by the hand and placing him on his lap he said. 'O Ten-necked lord of Raksasas, O you having long arms, what desire of your may I satisfy? Do you tell me what for you have come hither.' Being thus addressed by Bali, Ravana said.

sa: इति भ्रातरमाश्वास्य हृष्टः सौमित्रिब्रवीत्। अथावृत्य महीं कृत्स्नां जगाम हरिवाहिनी॥
en: Having thus consoled his brother, Sumitrā's son, feeling enlivened, said this. The monkeyhost went on, covering the earth.

sa: तथा दृष्ट्वा तु वृत्तान्त त्वरमाणो विनिर्गतः। विनिर्गम्याब्रवीत्सर्वं रावणाय निशाचरः॥ अथ राम दशग्रीवः पुष्पकादवरुह्य सः। प्रवेष्टुमिच्छन्वेश्माथ भिन्नाञ्जनचयोपमः॥
en: Beholding that the night-ranger speedily issued out of the house and communicated it to Rāvana. Thereupon, O Rama, having descended from Pus paka, the Ten-necked demon, black as collyrium, entered that house.

sa: प्रस्तरेषु च रम्येषु विविधाः काननद्रुमाः। वायुवेगप्रचलिताः पुष्पैरवकिरन्ति तान्॥
en: And seated on picturesque rocks, various forest trees, shaken by the wind, showered flowers on them.

sa: अन्योन्यं प्लावयन्ति स्म शैलमारुह्य वानराः। फलान्यमृतगन्धीनि मूलानि कुसुमानि च।८७।। बभञ्जुर्वानरास्तत्र पादपानां मदोत्कटाः। द्रोणमात्रप्रमाणानि लम्बमानानि वानराः॥ ययुः पिबन्तः स्वस्थास्ते मधूनि मधुपिङ्गलाः। पादपानवभञ्जन्तो विकर्षन्तस्तथा लताः॥ विधमन्तो गिरिवरान्प्रययुः प्लवगर्षभाः। वृक्षेभ्योऽन्ये तु कपयो नदन्तो मधुदर्पिताः॥ अन्ये वृक्षान्प्रपद्यन्ते प्रपिबन्त्यपि चापरे। बभूव वसुधा तैस्तु संपूर्णा हरिपुङ्गवैः । यथा कलमकेदारैः पक्वैरिव वसुंधरा ॥
en: Ascending the mount these monkeys continually bounded. And excited with drink, they crumbled into pieces the ambrosia-smelling fruits, roots and flowers of the trees. And those monkeys yellow as honey, delighted, feasted on mangoes, long and measuring a Drona. Breaking down the trees, blasting the creepers, bounding from one tree to another and making the mount Sahya echo, those leading monkeys went on delighted and excited with drink. Some ascending the trees, and others drinking, the whole earth was enveloped with those monkeys, and seemed as if beautified with ripe paddy crops.

sa: कदा नु राक्षसेन्द्रस्य निधायोरसि सायकान्। शोकं प्रत्याहरिष्यामि शोकमुत्सृज्य मानसम्॥
en: When shall I, piercing with my shafts the breast of the lord of Raksasas, renounce my mind's grief?

sa: प्रतिपूज्य यथान्यायं रावणं ते महारथाः। तस्थुः प्राञ्जलयः सर्वे भर्तुर्विजयकाङ्गिणः॥
en: Those mighty car-warrior, worshipping Rāvana, and desiring the victory of their lord, stood before them with folded hands.

sa: तिष्ठ वा किं महाराज श्रमेण तव वानरान्। अयमेको महाराज इन्द्रजित्क्षपयिष्यति॥
en: Do you wait here, O great king; you need not take any trouble, Indrajit alone shall slay all these monkeys.

sa: महोदरं महापार्श्व विरूपाक्षं च राक्षसम्। शीघ्रं वदत सैन्यानि निर्यातेति ममाज्ञया॥
en: Mahodara, Mahāpārsva, Virāpāksa "Do you speedily speak to the soldiers that they should sally out for battle at my command.

sa: स तु दीर्घ विनिःश्वस्य मुहूर्तं ध्यानमास्थितः। बभूव परमक्रुद्धो रावणो भीमदर्शनः॥
en: And sighing hard he engaged in mediations for some time. And terrible-looking as he was greatly worked up with ire.

sa: तमेव त्वं महाराज विसृजेन्द्रजितं सुतम्। यावद्वानरसेनां तां सरामां नयति क्षयम्॥
en: Do you, O great king, entrust Indrajit with this business, until he bring to destruction the monkey-host along with Rāma.

sa: तरस्विनौ धारयता मृगस्य सत्त्वेन रूपं मनुजेन्द्रपुत्रौ। नूनं विशस्तौ मम कारणात् तौ सिंहर्षभौ द्वाविव वैद्युतेन॥
en: Verily for me, those two powerful, lion-like sons of the king, have been killed by (this demon) effulgent like the lightning and assuming the semblance of a deer.

sa: ततोऽग्निसाक्षिकं सख्यं कृतवांस्तत्र रावणः। निवातकवचैः सार्धं प्रीतिमानभवत्तदा ॥
en: Thereat Rāvaņa made friendship with the Nivātakavacas in the presence of Fire; and then rejoiced greatly.

sa: प्रहस्तस्य वचः श्रुत्वा राजा राज्यहितैषिणः। सुखेप्सुः सुहृदां मध्ये व्याजहार स रावणः॥
en: Hearing the speech of Prahasta seeking the welfare of the kingdom, Rāvaņa craving for enjoyment, spoke in the midst of his aderents.

sa: स तु भोगवतीं गत्वा पुरीं वासुकिपालिताम्। कृत्वा नागान्वशे हृष्टो ययौ मणिमयीं पुरीम्॥
en: Arriving at Bhogavati the city governed by Vāsuki, he brought the serpents under subjection and then, delighted, bent his course to the palace Manimayi.

sa: ततो रसातलं रक्षः प्रविष्टः पयसां निधिम्। दैत्योरगगणाध्युष्टं वरुणेन सुरक्षितम्॥
en: Then the Rākṣasa entered the region of waters the abode of Daityas and serpents, well protected by Varuna.

sa: निमित्तभूतमेतत् तु श्रोतुमस्या महत् प्रियम्। दृश्यते च स्फुरच्चक्षुः पद्मपत्रमिवायतम्॥ ईषच्च हृषितो वास्या दक्षिणाया ह्यदक्षिणः। अकस्मादेव वैदेह्याः बाहुरेकः प्रकम्पते॥
en: Behold! there, her left eye, spacious, as a lotus-petals, is dancing to hear this pleasant dream announcing the satisfaction of her own end. And her left arm is also dancing with joy, all on a sudden.

sa: ते प्रयाता महात्मानः पार्थिवास्ते प्रहृष्टवत्। गजवाजिसहस्रौषैः कम्पयन्तो वसुंधराम्॥
en: Having agitated the earth with thousands of elephants and horses the kings proceeded to various quarters.

sa: तच्च तस्य तथा मन्ये ज्ञातमासीन्महात्मनः। अथ संकुपितो वेधा मामिदं वाक्यमब्रवीत्॥
en: That high-souled one received information of all that I had done; and thereat, waxing enraged, the Deity spoke to me.

sa: आस्ये तस्या निमज्जन्तं ददृशुः सिद्धचारणाः॥ ग्रस्यमानं यथा चन्द्रं पूर्णं पर्वणि राहुणा।
en: And the Siddhas and Chāraņas saw him sink in her mouth, as the full Moon is taken by Rāhu during a Parva.

sa: ततो मृत्युः क्रुद्धतरो वैवस्वतमभाषत। मुञ्च मां समरे यावद्धन्मीमं पापराक्षसम्॥
en: Then Death, growing still more wroth, addressed Vaivasvata saying; “Let me go. I shall slay this sinful Rākşasa.”

sa: इत्युक्तः परुषं वाक्यं न्यायवादी विभीषणः। उत्पपात गदापाणिश्चतुर्भिः सह राक्षसैः॥
en: Being thus accosted harshly, Vibhisana, speaking truth, rose up along with four Rākṣasas having maces in their hands.

sa: इत्युक्त्वा परुषं वाक्यं रावणं रावणानुजः। आजगाम मुहूर्तेन यत्र रामः सलक्ष्मणः॥
en: Having addressed Rāvana with these harsh words, his younger brother, reached in no time, where Rāma along with Lakṣmaṇa was.

sa: कृतान्येव सुघोराणि रामेण रजनीचराः। रणे रामस्य ददृशुः कर्माण्यसुकाराणि ते॥
en: The night-rangers only espied the dreadful feats performed by Råma and which were above the power of others.

sa: पीत्वा तैलं प्रमत्ताश्च प्रहसन्त्यो महास्वनाः। लङ्कायां भस्मरूक्षायां सर्वा राक्षसयोषितः॥
en: And in Lanka, covered with dust, Raksasa women laughing and making terrible sound, were engaged in quaffing oil.

sa: रावणेन प्रणीतं हि तमवेहि विभीषणम्। तस्याहं निग्रहं मन्ये क्षमं क्षमवतां वर॥
en: O you the foremost of forgiving persons, I consider this Vibhīşaņa, who has been despatched by Ravana, worthy of being slain. as

sa: सर्वे भवन्तः सर्वेण हस्त्यश्वेन समावृताः। निर्यात रथसङ्घश्च हस्त्यश्वैश्चोपशोभिताः॥ एकं रामं परिक्षिप्य समरे हन्तुमर्हथ। प्रहृष्टाः शरवर्षाणि प्रावृट्काल इवाम्बुदाः॥
en: Do you all proceed to battle with elephants, horses and cars. And encircling Rāma only and discharging shafts at him, delightedly, like to clouds, in the rainy season, poring water, do you slay him.

sa: तस्मादेकैकशस्तावब्रुवन्तु सचिवास्तव। हेतुतो मतिसंपन्नाः समर्थाश्च पुनस्तथा॥
en: Let the intelligent and capable counsellors deliver their reasonable opinions to you.

sa: भावमस्य तु विज्ञाय तत्त्वतस्त्वं करिष्यसि। यदि दुष्टो न दुष्टो वा बुद्धिपूर्वं नरर्षभ॥
en: Do you first ascertain, O foremost of men, with what intention he has come evil or good and then settle what course to adopt.

sa: यथाशक्ति मयोक्तं त राक्षसस्यार्जवं प्रति। प्रमाणं त्वं हि शेषस्य श्रुत्वा बुद्धिमतां वर॥
en: O you the foremost of the intelligent, I have spok thus considering him sincere. It now behove you to perform what you think proper.

sa: विसर्जयामास तदा कौसल्याप्रीतिवर्धनः। राघवेण कृतानुज्ञः काशेयो ह्यकुतोभयः॥ वाराणसी ययौ तूर्णं राघवेण विसर्जितः।
en: Having taken farewell from Rāma enhancing Kausalya's delight, the king of Kasi, with his followers, fearlessly and speedily proceeded to his own city Vārāṇasī.

sa: ममापि च विवक्षास्ति काचित्प्रति विभीषणम्। श्रोतुमिच्छामि तत्सर्वं भवद्भिः श्रेयसि स्थितैः॥
en: I have also thought of some thing regarding Vibhisana. I wish you all, interested in my wellbeing, to hear that.

sa: ऋषेः कण्वस्य पुत्रेण कण्डुना परमर्षिणा। शृणु गाथा पुरा गीता धर्मिष्ठा सत्यवादिना॥
en: Do you hear, I shall relate, a sacred story, narrated by the great ascetic, the truthful Kandu, son of the ascetic Kanyā.

sa: स चेद्रयाद्वा मोहाद्वा कामाद्वापि न रक्षति। स्वया शक्त्या यथान्यायं तत्पापं लोकगर्हितम्॥
en: One, who from fear, ignorance or wilfully does not protect him who seek his shelter, perpetrate a mighty iniquity, blamed of all.

sa: रामस्य तु वचः श्रुत्वा सुग्रीवः प्लवगेश्वरः। प्रत्यभाषत काकुत्स्थं सौहार्दैनाभिपूरितः॥
en: Hearing the words of Rāma, Sugriva, the lords of those who go bounding, over-flowing with friendliness, bespake Kākutstha.

sa: दाराः पुत्राः पुरं राष्ट्र भोगाच्छादनभोजनम्। सर्वमेवाविभक्तं नौ भविष्यति हरीश्वर॥
en: O king of monkeys, from today, wife sons, city, kingdom, enjoyment, cloth and food shall be our common,

sa: येन लोकस्वयः सेन्द्राः क्लिश्यन्ते सचराचराः। क्षीणे चायुषि धर्मेण स कालो जेष्यते कथम्॥
en: How can (Ravana) conquer Time who, when its life wane, righteously visit with affection the time, sphere with Indra, fraught with mobile and immobile.

sa: एवमुक्तस्तु धर्मात्मा प्रत्युवाच विभीषणः। समुद्रं राघवो राजा शरणं गन्तुमर्हसि॥
en: Being thus addressed, the virtuous-souled Vibhisana replied, "It behovth the king, Rāghava, to seek refuge from the Ocean.

sa: अभ्यधावन्त समरे निषादान् सह राजभिः। ततः प्रववृते युद्धं घोररूपं भयावहम्॥
en: And with many other kings, rushed with great force against the Nishadas. Then took place a fearful and terrible battle.

sa: अभावः सहसा राजन् कुरुराजस्य तर्कितः॥ हतप्रवीरास्तु वयं निकृत्ताश्च शितैः शरैः।
en: O king, the destruction of the Kuru monarch became apparent. Mangled with sharp shafts and with our foremost heroes slain,

sa: ततः स राक्षसः क्रुद्धः सम्प्राप्यैवार्जुनि रणे। नातिदूरे स्थितां तस्य द्रावयामास वै चमूम्॥
en: Then that Rakshasa, encountering the son of Arjuna, began to crush, in rage, the latter's divisions even, those that were not far from him.

sa: ततः प्रत्यागतप्राणाः सर्वे ते सुबलात्मजाः। भूयः क्रोधसमाविष्टा इरावन्तमभिद्रुताः॥
en: Then all those sons of Subala regaining consciousness, possessed by rage, once more rushed towards Iravat.

sa: तान् सर्वान् पतितान् दृष्ट्वा भीतो दुर्योधनस्ततः। अभ्यधावत संक्रुद्धो राक्षसं घोरदर्शनम्॥
en: Then your son Duryodhana beholding all those heroes crushed, waxing worth, said these words unto the Rakshasa of fearful appearance,

sa: कृत्वा घोरं महद् रूपं ग्रहीतुमुपचक्रमे। अर्जुनस्य सुतं वीरमिरावन्तं यशस्विनम्॥
en: Assuming a dreadful and prodigious form he tried to capture the son of Arjuna, namely the illustrious Iravat.

sa: न त्वेवाहं न गमिष्यामि तेषां मध्ये शूराणां तत्र चाहं ब्रवीमि। मित्रQहो दुर्बलभक्तयो ये पापात्मानो न ममैते सहायाः॥
en: It is not that, I say, that I shall not go amidst those heroes. Those that sow dissension's among friends, that are of veering devotion and of impious souls those are not my allies.

sa: कर्माणि च यथापूर्वं कृत्वा नाभिवदन्ति माम्। अपि स्वस्ति भवेदध भ्रातृभ्यो मम माधव॥
en: Duly performing the ceremonies one after another, they do not come forward to salute me. O Madhava, is everything well with all my brothers?

sa: क्षणेन स रथस्तस्य सहयः सहसारथिः। शरवर्षेण महता संछन्नो न प्रकाशते॥
en: In a moment (Arjuna's) car with its standard and charioteer became invisible having been covered with that shower of arrows.

sa: तं तु दृष्ट्वा तदा राजन् देवी देवपरं तदा। अर्चा प्रयुञ्जानमथो भार्या वचनमब्रवीत्॥
en: Thereupon, perceiving him to be devoted to the gods, O king, and paying his worship, his wife, that goddess like lady spoke these words.

sa: ततः सैन्येषु भग्नेषु मथितेषु च सर्वशः। प्राप्ते चास्तं दिनकरे न प्राज्ञायत किंचन॥
en: When the Pandava troops were thus routed and crushed all over the field, the sun set, the night came, and nothing could be seen.

sa: तस्य तद् वचनं श्रुत्वा शिखण्डी क्रोधमूर्छितः। उवाचैनं तथ पीष्मं सृक्किणी परिसंलिहन्॥
en: You are even now the same Shikhandin as the creator made you before. Hearing these words of his, Shikhandin overwhelmed with rage,

sa: संजय उवाच पुण्यं श्रुत्वैतदाख्यानं महाराज सुतस्तव। केशवं बहु मेने स पाण्डवांश्च महारथान्॥
en: Sanjaya said Your son, O mighty monarch, listening to this sacred story, began to regard highly Keshava and those mighty car-warriors, the sons Pandu.

sa: एवमुक्ता तु सा तेन शाल्वेनादीर्घदर्शिना। निश्चक्राम पुराद् दीना रुदती कुररी यथा॥
en: Being thus spoken to by that Shalva of short foresight, she issued out of that city sorrowing, weeping like a she osprey.

sa: उपावृत्तमदः क्षिप्रमभ्यवर्तत वेगितः। स प्रदुद्राव वेगेन प्रणदन् भैरवं रवम्॥
en: With its fury quenched, turned back with great vehemence; then that elephant uttering dreadful roars of agony ran,

sa: एवं संभाषमाणौ तु दृष्ट्वा शोकपरायणौ। शिखण्डिनी तदा कन्या वीडितेव तपस्विनी॥
en: Perceiving those two, overwhelmed with grief, talking to each other, that daughter Shikhandin, ascetic as she was, filled with shame.

sa: ततः शल्यो महाराज धृष्टद्युम्नस्य संयुगे। धनुश्चिच्छेद भल्लेन पीतेन निशितेन च।॥
en: Then, O mighty monarch, in that fight, Shalya cut down the bow of Dhrishtadyumna with a keen pointed yellow dare.

sa: तस्य तत् पूजयामास लाघवं शान्तनोः सुतः। साधु पार्थ महाबाहो साधु भोः पाण्डुनन्दन॥
en: Thereupon the son of Shantanu (Bhishma) praised his lightness of hand by saying, “O Partha. O son of Pandu, O mighty-armed hero, 'Excellent, Excellent'.

sa: स मुहूर्त तथा ध्यात्वा पुनरेवाब्रवीद् वचः। असंशयं पार्थिवेन्द्र कालः संक्षियते जगत्॥
en: Having meditated for a moment, Vyasa thus again spoke, O king of kings, “there is no doubt that Time destroys the Universe.

sa: अस्माकं तु विशिष्टा ये तान् निबोध द्विजोत्तम। नायका मम सैन्यस्य संज्ञार्थं तान् ब्रवीमि ते॥
en: O best of Brahmanas, learn, I shall tell you also for your information who are the most distinguished amongst us, and who are the leaders of my army.

sa: पञ्चालानां च ये श्रेष्ठा राजपुत्रा महारथाः। तेषामादत्त तेजांसि जलं सूर्य इवांशुभिः॥
en: Of those who were the foremost princes amongst the Panchalas, he robbed the strength, like the sun drawing moisture with its rays.

sa: भूतं भव्यं भविष्यं च मार्कण्डेयोऽभ्युवाच ह। यज्ञं त्वां चैव यज्ञानां तपश्च तपसामपि॥
en: Markandeya has spoken of you as the Past, the Present, and the Future, the sacrifice of all sacrifices and the Austerity of all austerities.

sa: धार्तराष्ट्रस्य शिविरे मया प्रणिहिताश्चराः। त इमे शीघ्रमागम्य प्रवृत्तिं वेदयन्ति नः॥
en: I had deputed spies in the encampment of the sons of Dhristarastra. Those spies, returning soon furnished with this information.

sa: यथा नागो वने नागं मत्तो मत्तमुपाद्रवत्॥ कृपश्च समरे शूरो माद्रीपुत्रं महारथम्। आजधान शरैस्तूर्णं सप्तत्या रुक्मभूषणैः॥ तस्य माद्रीसुतश्चापं द्विधा चिच्छेद सायकैः। अथैनं छिन्नधन्वानं विव्याध नवभिः शरैः॥
en: Like one infuriated elephants rushing against a compeer in the same state, in the woods. Then the heroic Kripa quickly pierced that mighty car-warrior the son of Madri with seventy shafts all decked with golden wings. Then the son of Madri burst his bow in twain with his strong shafts.

sa: संजय उवाच तस्मिन् महति संक्रन्दे राजा दुर्योधनस्तदा। गाङ्गेयमुपसंगम्य विनयेनाभिवाद्य च॥
en: Sanjaya said When that dreadful battle was over, king Duryodhana, approaching the son of Ganga, and saluting him with humility,

sa: भीमसेनं तु कौन्तेयं सोदर्याः पर्यवारयन्। विविंशतिचित्रसेनो विकर्णश्च महारथः॥
en: His brothers, Vivinshati, Chitrasena and the mighty car-warrior Vikarna, opposed Kunti's son Bhimasena in the battle.

sa: ततो विह्वलमानं तं निःश्वसन्तं पुनः पुनः। शल्यमभ्यपतत् तूर्णे कृतवर्मा महारथः॥
en: Thereupon the mighty car-warrior Kritavarman speedily came to Shalya's rescue who was deprived of his senses and was breathing quickly.

sa: विकीर्णैः कवचैश्चित्रैः शिरस्त्राणैश्च मारिष। शुशुभे तद् रणस्थानं शरदीव नभस्तलम्॥
en: O sire, strewn with various coloured armours and turbans the battle field looked beautiful like the autumn sky.

sa: ते चैनं भृशसंतप्ताः शरवर्षैरवाकिरन्। स च तांश्छादयामास शरजालैः पुनः पुनः॥
en: Greatly afflicted, they also covered Karna with a down-pour of arrows. Karna also covered them repeatedly with showers of arrows.

sa: तिष्ठ स्थितोऽस्मि विद्ध्येनं निवर्तस्व स्थिरो भव। स्थिरोऽस्मि प्रहरस्वेति शब्दोऽश्रूयत सर्वशः॥
en: “Stay”, “Hear stand I”, “Turn back” “Stand” "O wait for you” “Strike" these were the words that were heard everywhere.

sa: यावत् तिष्ठन्ति समरे हतशेषाः सहोदराः। नृपाश्च बहवो राजस्तावत् संधिः प्रयुज्यताम्॥
en: As still, O king, these your uterine brothers and these myriad kings here survive the battle, let peace be concluded.

sa: अब्रवीत् समितौ तस्यां वासुदेवस्य शृण्वतः॥ धृष्टद्युम्न निबोधेदं यत् त्वां वक्ष्यामि मारिष।
en: In that assembly and in the hearing of Vasudeva. "O Dhrishtadyumna, O descendant of Prishata, mark the words I speak to you.

sa: लुप्तधर्मा परेणासि धर्मं दर्शय वै सुतान्। किं ते राज्येन दुर्धर्ष येन प्राप्तोऽसि किल्बिषम्॥
en: Your virtue suffers a great diminution. Show to your son what is virtuous. O invincible hero, of what value is a kingdom that brings in sin?

sa: धृतराष्ट्र उवाच यथा भवान् वेत्ति तथैव वेत्ता भावाभावौ विदितौ मे यथार्थो। कौरवाः॥ स्वार्थे हि सम्मुह्यति तात लोको मां चापि लोकात्मकमेव विद्धि॥
en: Dhritarashtra said My knowledge of life and death is the same as yours. The truth of this is well known to me. But men lose (good) judgement in things which concern their interest. O sire, know me to be an ordinary man.

sa: संजय उवाच एवमुक्तो हृषीकेशो गुडाकेशेन भारत। सेनयोरुभयोर्मध्ये स्थापयित्वा रथोत्तमम्॥
en: Sanjaya said O Bharata, thus addressed by Gudakesha (Arjuna), Hrishikesh, placing the excellent car between the two armies.

sa: भीष्मद्रोणप्रमुखतः सर्वेषां च महीक्षिताम्। उवाच पार्थ पश्यैतान् समवेतान् कुरूनिति॥
en: In front of Bhishma, Drona and all the kings of the earth, said, “Behold Partha, the assembled Kaurava".

sa: भजस्व मां शाल्वपते भक्ता बालामनागसम्। भक्तानां हि परित्यागो न धर्मेषु प्रशस्यते॥
en: Accept me, O lord of the Shalvas, accept a girl who is innocent. No religion approves of the direction of the devoted.

sa: प्रासैरभिहताः केचिद् गजयोधाः समन्ततः। पतमानाः स्म दृश्यन्ते गिरिशृङ्गान्नगा इव॥
en: Some elephant-warriors struck down with Prasas, falling on the ground appeared like mountain trees overthrown from the peaks.

sa: व्यूढं दृष्ट्वा तु तत् सैन्यं पिता देवव्रतस्तव। क्रौञ्चैन महता राजन् प्रत्यव्यूहत वाहिनीम्॥
en: Beholding the troops of the Pandavas thus disposed of, your sire Devavrata, O king, arranged his troops in a counter-array figuring a huge crane.

sa: धृतराष्ट्र उवाच प्रतिज्ञाते ततस्तस्मिन् युद्धे भीष्मेण दारुणे। क्रोधितो मम पुत्रेण दुःखितेन विशेषतः॥ भीष्मः किमकरोत् तत्र पाण्डवेयेषु संभारतगे। पितामहे वा पञ्चालास्तन्ममाचक्ष्व संजय॥
en: Dhritarashtra said When enraged by the words of my son, O Sanjaya, Bhishma took thai fearful vow in the battle, what did he do to the Pandavas, and what did the Panchalas do to the grandsire? O Sanjaya, tell me all this.

sa: भवितव्यं तथा तद्धि मम दुःखाय कौरव। भद्रे कामं करिष्यामि समयं तु निबोध मे॥
en: Truly, it was decreed to be so for my (Bhishma's) grief, O Kaurava. "O fair one I will accomplish your wish, but listen to a condition.

sa: श्रुतायुश्च शतायुश्च सौमदत्तिश्च मारिष। व्यूहस्य जघने तस्थू रक्षमाणाः परस्परम्॥ ततो युद्धाय संजग्मुः पाण्डवाः कौरवैः सह। सूर्योदये महाराज ततो युद्धमभून्महत्॥
en: Shrutayush and Shatayush and the some of Somadatta, O Sire, supporting one another, stood in the rear of that array. Then the Pandavas rushed to battle with the Kurus. At sun rise, O mighty monarch, the engagement commenced.

sa: गच्छ भद्रे पुनस्तत्र सकाशंभीष्मकस्य वै। नाहमिच्छामि भीष्मेण गृहीतां त्वां प्रसह्य वै॥
en: Go therefore, gentle lady, again to Bhishma. I dot desire to have you who had been taken away by Bhishma by force.

sa: समं सर्वेषु भूतेषु तिष्ठन्तं परमेश्वरम्। विनश्यत्स्वविनश्यन्तं यः पश्यति स पश्यति॥
en: He sees truly who sees the supreme Lord alike in all beings and who sees the Imperishable in the perishable.

sa: यत् तत् परमकं गुह्यं त्वत्प्रसादादिदं विभो। वासुदेव तदेतत् ते मयोद्गीतं यथातथम्॥
en: 0 Vasudeva all that is supremely mysterious regarding you, O Lord, all that have been exactly sung by me, through your grace.

sa: पुरा सर्वान् प्रमथाति बृह्यस्य वधमाशु नः। ततो द्रोणो महेष्वासः सर्वांस्तान् प्रत्यभाषत॥
en: "Tell us the means of his death, before he slays us all.” Thereupon the fierce bow-man Drona replied to them all saying-

sa: धर्मसंस्थापनार्थाय दैत्यानां च वधाय च। जगतो धारणार्थाय विज्ञाप्यं कुरु मे विभो॥
en: Gratify my solicitation O Lord, for the sake of establishing righteousness, for slaying the sons of Diti and for upholding the universe.

sa: तस्मिंस्तथा वर्तमाने संग्रामे लोमहर्षणे। भगदत्तो महेष्वासो भीमसेनमथाद्रवत्॥
en: When that hair string combat was thus raging, the fierce bowmen Bhagadatta assailed Bhimasena,

sa: पुनरावर्ततां तेषां वेग आसीद् विशाम्पते। पूर्यतः सागरस्येव चन्द्रस्योदयनं प्रति॥
en: O king, the army thus rallied appeared then like the surging sea at the time of moon's rising.

sa: श्रुतायुस्तु ततः क्रुद्धः फाल्गुनेः समरे हयान्। निजघान गदाग्रेण ततो युद्धमवर्तत॥
en: Shruthayusha, in the battle the horses of the son of Arjuna with a great mace and then they fought on.

sa: जहि भीष्मं स्थिरो भूत्वा शृणु चेदं वचो मम। यथोवाच पुरा शक्रं महाबुद्धिवृहस्पतिः॥
en: Do you slay Bhishma, with great coolness. Hear also these words of mine which were said to Shakra formerly by the highly intelligent Brihaspati.

sa: तमुद्यतगदं दृष्ट्वा सशृङ्गमिव पर्वतम्। तावकानां भयं घोरं समपद्यत भारत॥
en: Beholding him with the uplifted mace resemble a crested mountain, your troops, O Bharata, were seized with panic.

sa: संजय उवाच हते तस्मिन् गजानीके पुत्रो दुर्योधनस्तव। भीमसेनं नतेत्येवं सर्वसैन्यान्यचोदयत्॥
en: Sanjaya said When that division of elephants had been crushed, your son Duryodhana, commanded his whole force saying, Kill Bhimasena.

sa: पटच्चरैश्च पौण्ड्रैश्च राजन् पौरवकैस्तथा॥ निषादैः सहितश्चापि पृष्ठमासीद् युधिष्ठिरः।
en: O king, Yudhishthira with the Patachcharas, the Pundras, the Puravakas and the Nishadas, became its back.

sa: अर्जुनस्तु ततः क्रुद्धस्तव सैन्यं विशाम्पते। ववर्ष शरवर्षेण धाराभिरिव तोयदः॥
en: O king, then Arjuna angrily poured shower of arrows on your army as clouds pour rain in torrents..

sa: धनंजयस्य रूपेण विक्रमेण श्रुतेन च। विनयात् सहदेवस्य सदृशो नकुलस्य च॥
en: He was equal to Dhananjaya in beauty of person, prowess and scriptural knowledge and to Nakula and Sahadeva in humility.

sa: वीरबाहुश्च ते पुत्रो वैराटि रथसत्तमम्। उत्तरं योधयामास विव्याध निशितैः शरैः॥
en: Your son Virabahu fought with that foremost of car-warriors, Uttara, the son of Virata and wounded him with nine arrows.

sa: ये च कृष्णेगुणाः स्फीताः पाण्डवेषु च ये गुणा:। अभिमनयौ किलैकस्था दृश्यन्ते गुणसंचयाः॥
en: All those illustrious qualities that are present mostly in Krishna and in the Pandavas, all those qualities were to be seen combined in Abhimanyu.

sa: सौभद्रः पौरवं त्वन्यैर्विद्ध्वा सप्तभिराशुगैः। पञ्चभिस्तस्य विव्याध हयान् सूतं च सायकैः॥
en: Then the son of Subhadra having pierced Paurava with seven swiftly-flying arrows, pierced with five shafts his charioteer and horses.

sa: संवत्सरस्थायिनौ च ग्रहौ प्रज्वलितावुभौ। विशाखायाः समीपस्थौ बृहस्पतिशनैश्चरौ॥
en: Those two burning planets namely Brihaspati and Shani have become fixed for a year.

sa: य एनं वेत्ति हन्तारं यश्चैनं मन्यते हतम्। उभौ तौ न विजानीतो नायं हन्ति न हन्यते॥
en: He, who thinks that It (the great Self in many) is the killer and he who thinks that It is killed, both know nothing. It neither kills, nor is killed.

sa: संजय उवाच यन्मां पृच्छसि राजेन्द्र सौभद्रस्य निपातनम्। तत् ते कात्स्येन वक्ष्यामि शृणु राजन् समाहितः॥२६
en: Sanjaya said That which you ask me to describe, O foremost of kings, viz., the slaughter of Subhadra's son, I shall describe in detail, Hear, O king, attentively.

sa: संजय उवाच स्वसैन्यं निहतं दृष्ट्वा राजा दुर्योधनः स्वयम्। अभ्यधावत संक्रुद्धो भीमसेनमरिंदमम्॥
en: Sanjaya said There upon king Duryodhana, seeing his own troops slain inflamed with wrath, rushed against that subduer of foes namely Bhimasena.

sa: बभञ्ज च सहस्त्राणि दश राज्ञां महात्मनाम् सृजतामशिवा वाचः खड्गकार्मुकधारिणाम्।। २३
en: Then ten thousand high-souled kings broke away. Uttering abusive language (againsi Duryodhana), armed though they were with swords and bows.

sa: स्तस्मिन् विमर्दे महति प्रवृत्ते। अयं दुरात्मा दुपदस्य पुत्रः समागतो भीमसेनेन सार्धम्॥
en: Thereat, in that conflict, your son, approaching his brothers, quickly said to them. "This wicked-souled son of Drupada has now joined Bhimasena.

sa: तांस्तु प्रत्यवधीत् सर्वान् दशभिर्दशभिः शरैः। तैरर्चमानः सौभद्रः सर्वतो निशितैः शरैः॥ तं कोसलानामधिपः कर्णिनाताडयद्धृदि। स तस्याश्वान् ध्वजं चापं सूतं चापातयत् क्षितौ॥
en: In return, Abhimanyu pierced each of them with ten shafts. Then the ruler of the Kosalas pierced him on the breast with a barbed dart. Abhimanyu then felled on the ground his horses, his standards, his bow and his charioteer.

sa: कर्णो द्वाविंशतिं भल्लान् कृतवर्मा च विंशतिम्। बृहद्बलस्तु पञ्चाशत् कृपः शारद्वतो दश॥
en: Karna then pierced Abhimanyu with lwenty-two broad-headed shafts. Kritavarman with fourteen, Brihadbala with fifty and Kripa the son of Saradvata with ten.

sa: शंस मे तद् यथा चासीद् युद्धं भीष्मस्य पाण्डवैः। योषेव हतवीरा मे सेना पुत्रस्य संजय॥
en: Tell me how the battle was fought between the Pandavas and Bhishma? O Sanjaya, my army, deprived of its hero, is now like a woman without a protector.

sa: पिबत स्नात खादध्वमिति यद् रोचते जनाः। यस्मै प्रादाद् वरं रुद्रस्तुष्टः पुण्येन कर्मणा॥
en: "Drink" "bathe" 'eat' and 'do as like,' these were the words that used to be heard there. Pleased with his deeds of piety, Rudra

sa: युधिष्ठिर उवाच त्वयि याते महाबाहो संशप्तकबलं प्रति। प्रयत्नमकरोत् तीव्रमाचार्यो ग्रहणे मम॥
en: Yudhishthira said When, O mighty-armed one, you had gone against the Samshaptaka hosts, the preceptor Drona exerted himself vigourously for capturing me.

sa: यस्य वीर्यं समाश्रित्य मम पुत्रो बृहद्बलः। न पाण्डवानगणयत् कथं स निहतः परैः॥
en: Alas, how has that greatly powerful warrior, relying on whose prowess my son never cared for the Pandavas, been (today) killed by the enemy?

sa: कृष्णार्जुनावेकरथौ दिव्यौ शङ्खौ प्रदध्मतुः। य इदं पठते स्तोत्र कल्य उत्थाय मानवः॥
en: Then Krishna and Arjuna, both seated in one car, blew their celestial conchs. The man, who chants this hymn in the morning.

sa: जित्वा तु दुपदं द्रोण: शङ्ख दध्मौ प्रतापवान्। तस्य शङ्खस्वनं श्रुत्वा वित्रेसुः सर्वसोमकाः॥
en: Thereupon the highly powerful Drona, having vanquished Drupada, sounded his conch. Hearing the blare of his conch, all the Somakas were struck with terror.

sa: तथैव पाण्डवाः सर्वे महत्या सेनया सह। द्रोणभीष्मौ रणे यत्तौ प्रत्युद्ययुररिंदमौ॥
en: The Pandava also with many thousand troops rushed in battle against those chastiser of foes, the heroic Bhishma and Drona.

sa: ततः कृत्वा तु राजा स आगमं प्रीतिमानथ। सम्बन्धिना समागम्य हृष्टो वासमुवास ह॥
en: Having made this test, the king gladdened at heart, going up to his kinsman (his daughter's father-in-law) lived with him (some time) with gladness.

sa: एवमामत्र्य ते वीराः पाण्डवाः पाण्डुपूर्वजम्। जग्मुस्ते सहितः सर्वे वासुदेवश्च वीर्यवान्॥
en: Having thus consulted, the heroic Pandavas, together with the highly powerful son of Vasudeva, went, O elder brother of Pandu,

sa: रक्षिता समरे नित्यं नित्यं चापि हिते रतः॥ सर्वथा त्वां समासाद्य नाश्चर्यमिति मे मतिः।
en: You always protect in battle, and for whose welfare you always concern yourself. Having yourself for our protector, I do not consider anything wonderful for us."

sa: तेन मुक्ता: शरा घोरा विचेरुः सर्वतोदिशम्। त्रासयन्तो महाराज पाण्डेयस्य वाहिनीम्॥
en: Dreadful shafts shot by him, whizzed in all directions, terrifying, O monarch, the army belonging to the son of Pandu.

sa: त्वं हि नः शरणं कृष्ण भक्तानामभयंकरः॥ अनाश्चर्यो जयस्तेषां येषां त्वमसि केशव।
en: You are sole refuge, O Krishna: You give assurances of safety to your devotees. Victory is not a marvel for those whom,OKeshava,

sa: तं तु दुर्योधनः षष्ट्या विद्ध्वा भीमं महाबलम्। त्रिभिरन्वैः सुनिशितैर्विशोकं प्रत्यविध्यत॥
en: Thereat Duryodhana, having pierced in return Bhima of superior strength with sin arrows, pierced Vishoka with another three well-sharpened shafts.

sa: मानं कुरुष्व गाड्नेय ब्राह्मणस्य रणाजिरे। वयं तु गुरवस्तुभ्यं तस्मात् त्वां वारयामहे॥
en: O son of Ganga, do honour to this Brahmana on the field of battle. We are your superiors and therefore forbid you.

sa: भीमसेनोऽभिमन्युश्च राक्षश्च घटोत्कचः। द्रौपदेयाः सत्यधृतिः क्षत्रदेवश्च भारत॥
en: Bhimasena, Abhimanyu, the Rakshasa Ghatotkacha, the son of Draupadi, Satyadhriti, Kshatradeva, and O sire,

sa: तथैव तावकाः सर्वे पुरस्कृत्य यतव्रतम्। शिखण्डिप्रमुखान् पार्थान् योधयन्ति स्म संयुगे॥
en: Similarly all your warriors with Bhishma of regulated vows at their forefront fought with the Partha warriors headed by Shikhandin.

sa: पूर्वकालं तव मया प्रतिज्ञातं महाबल। हत्वा दशसहस्राणि क्षत्रियाणां महात्मनाम्॥
en: Before the battle commenced, O mighty hero, I vowed to you, that slaying ten thousand high-souled Kshatriya warriors.

sa: सेनापतिवचः श्रुत्वा पाण्डवानां वरूथिनी। भीष्मं समभ्यात् तूर्णं प्राणांस्त्यक्त्वा महाहवे॥
en: Hearing the words of their generallissimo, the division of the Pandavas disregarding their lives quickly rushed at Bhishma.

sa: कौरवास्तु ततो राजन् प्रययुः शिबिरं स्वकम्। वीडमाना निशाकाले पाण्डवेयैः पराजिताः॥
en: Thereafter, the Kauravas, at night fall haveily repaired to their own encampments, being ashamed and being vanquished by the Pandavas.

sa: स शत्रुभिः परिवृतो बहुधा रणमूर्धनि। व्यस्यन् बाणसहस्राणि योधेषु च गजेषु च॥
en: Surrounded by countless foes on the field of battle, he shot thousands of shafts at the warriors and elephants that encompassed him.

sa: ततो मूर्धन्युपाघ्राय पर्यश्रुनयना नृप। आह सत्यवती हृष्टा दिष्ट्या पुत्र जितं त्वया।॥
en: Then smelling my head, with eyes full of tears Satyavati cheerfully said to me. “By luck you have conquered them, my son."

sa: तत्रास्य गाथा गायन्ति ये पुराणविदो जनाः॥
en: People conversant with the history of the past ages sing this songs.

sa: सौमदत्तिं रणे शङ्खो रभसं रभसो युधि। प्रत्युद्ययौ महाराज तिष्ठ तिष्ठेति चाब्रवीत्॥
en: O king, the impetuous Shankha met Somadatta son who was equally impetuous in battle and he shouted out to him "Wait" “Wait".

sa: केकया भ्रातरः पञ्च धृष्टकेतुश्च वीर्यवान्। जघनं पालयामासुः पाण्डुसैन्यस्य भारत॥
en: The five Kaikeya brothers, and the highly powerful Dhrishtaketu, protected, O Bharata, the rear of the Pandava forces.

sa: संजय उवाच वर्तमाने तथा रौद्रे राजन् वीरवरक्षये। शकुनिः सौबलः श्रीमान् पाण्डवान् समुपाद्रवत्॥
en: Sanjaya said When, o king, that dreadful battle destructive of excellent heroes was thus raging, Subala's prosperous son Shakuni rushed against the Pandava hosts.
